reserveReview.rationale: The issuer Terms modified September 25, 2026 state directly that each base USDai is backed 1:1 by PYUSD and distinguish sUSDai as the separate loan-exposed vault. This disclosure supports the unchanged 100% PYUSD composition. At finalized Arbitrum block 518785675 (2026-10-27T15:56:26Z), canonical totalSupply() returned 265368641119851450135654744 raw 18-decimal units, bridgedSupply() returned 997964777241000000000000 raw 18-decimal units, and PYUSD.balanceOf(hub) returned 266366605910148 raw 6-decimal units (about 266,366,605.91 PYUSD against 266,366,605.90 USDai liabilities including bridged supply). These corroborating observations are base-token liabilities and hub collateral, not protocol TVL or the separate sUSDai portfolio.
